pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: Bubba G better bring more than his usual backyard BBQ game if he wants France to handle Ghost Pepper's Spain down in Arlington. France is lookin' sharp, but we all know Gunner's draftin' strategy was inspired by his barber's wild tales of a DR Congo Cinderella story. Meanwhile, Spain's been like Devin's homemade salsa — occasionally too hot to handle but just right when the pressure's on. This one's gonna be tighter than new boots on match day, but I'm callin' it for Ghost Pepper — he's gettin' spicy and takin' the W.

pundit_takes.subtitle: Gunner's first-place tactics aim to keep Devin at second place.
